description: Fixed price in EUR for a private AHM Transfer ride between two places in the Alanya / Antalya region of Turkey. The price is per vehicle (not per person) and the same in both directions. Returns "no list price" for pairs that are quoted on request. Known places: Gazipaşa Airport (GZP); Antalya Airport (AYT); Alanya Center; Mahmutlar / Kestel; Konaklı / Avsallar; Okurcalar / Türkler; Side / Manavgat. The airports are named "Antalya Airport (AYT)" and "Gazipaşa Airport (GZP)".
name: get_transfer_price
title: Get transfer price
